title: Corridor step 7 — both commits matched, the pool is funded
description: Polling the commit until EXECUTED is what tells a Central Bank the counterpart committed too and the relay funded the pool. Only then does the pool reach ACTIVE.
notes: Gateway: BCCR (Banco Central de Costa Rica) Central Bank gateway, spoke-crc. Requires the central_bank realm role — note that /api/v2 uses lowercase unprefixed roles, while /api/v1 uses the ROLE_-prefixed ones; both namespaces coexist in the same token's roles array. side comes back as A here because the on-chain resolver decided it, not because the request asked for it. The commit shape is declared free-form upstream; these fields are the ones the delivered endpoints and the platform's end-to-end test exchange, and no field is guaranteed present.
